name: Rank-Two Ample Classes Are Strictly Two-Dimensional
scope: Finite classes and finite partial cubes under the survey dictionary.
statement: Every ample class of VC dimension at most two is a two-dimensional partial cube, and the inclusion is strict.
proof: The inclusion is definitional. The six-cycle has VC dimension two but is not ample because it is the obstruction $Q_3^{--}$.
